Mali.title: Niono, Tessalit and Gourma-Rharous:...
Mali.summary: Niono, Tessalit and Gourma-Rharous: the Noose is tightening around terrorist groups As part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, carried out airstrikes in different localities of our country between 2 and 3 November 2026 . In a statement issued yesterday by the General Staff of the Armed Forces, it appears that on Monday, November 2, 2026, the use of precise information made it possible to locate, thirty kilometers east of Niono, a major base housing armed terrorist groups as well as war material, including armed vehicles.

Mali.title: Guinea: 22 directors expelled for complicity in illegal gold panning in Siguiri
Mali.summary: Guinea: 22 directors removed for complicity in illegal gold panning in Siguiri The Guinean President, Mamadi Doumbouya, signed on November 3, 2026 a decree deleting 22 territorial administrators, civilian and military, stationed in the Siguiri region. They are permanently excluded from the civil service and the defence and security forces The spokesman of the Presidency, General Amara Camara, read the decree on national television (RTG).

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Mali-Guinea: an influx of foreign nationals reported at the border
Mali.summary: Bamako, November 4 (AMAP) A large influx of nationals of various nationalities is currently observed at the border between Mali and Guinea, towards the District of Bamako, announced Wednesday the Crisis Coordination and Management Center (CECOGEC), in a statement of the Inter-Ministerial Committee for Crisis and Disaster Management This situation follows the measures taken by the Guinean authorities to put an end to clandestine and illegal gold panning on their territory, says the communiqué issued at the end of an emergency meeting held at the Ministry of Security and Civil Protection, under the chairmanship of…

Mali.title: Mali-Guinea: An influx of gold miners at the Kouremale border, CECOGEC announces reception measures...
Mali.summary: Mali-Guinea: Flux of gold miners at the Kouremale border, CECOGEC announces reception and repatriation measures The Ministry of Security and Civil Protection is sounding the alarm . In a press release No. 2026-05 published on November 3, 2026 and signed by Colonel Fireman Issa Raoul Dana DABO, the Center for Coordination and Crisis Management (CECOGEC) reports a large influx of nationals of various nationalities on the border between Mali and Guinea, towards the District of Bamako .

Mali.title: Mali-Guinea Border Migration: Security Authorities Take Charge
Mali.summary: COMMUNIQUÉ No. 2026-05 OF the INTERMINISTERIEL Committee FOR CRISIS and DISASTER MANAGEMENT Following an emergency meeting held today at the Ministry of Security and Civil Protection chaired by the Secretary General, the Crisis Coordination and Management Center (CECOGEC) informs national public opinion that a large influx of nationals of various nationalities is currently observed at the border between Mali and the Guinea, towards Bamako District.

Mali.title: Between Us: Realism
Mali.summary: By press release dated 24 October 2026, the General Staff of the Armed Forces announced the discovery, in a camp in Tagadayat about 35 km south-east of the city of Menaka, of 54 lifeless bodies . A week earlier, on October 19, the Executive Office of the Idaksahak Community spoke of "the massacre of 48 civilians, which occurred on Sunday, October 18, 2026, in the locality of Tagadayat, in the region of Menaka, by armed elements of Daesh, arrived on board several motorcycles" .

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso repatriates more than 8,000 nationals of Guinea after the ban on gold panning
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso repatriates more than 8,000 nationals from Guinea after gold panning ban The Burkinabe government has mobilized a convoy of hundreds of buses to repatriate more than 8,000 nationals from Guinea, in response to the ban on artisanal gold mining and a situation of increasing distress Burkina Faso is organizing the repatriation of thousands of its nationals from Guinea this week, after measures taken by Conakry against illegal gold panning, AFP learned Wednesday from a source in the Burkinabe government and a state media.

Burkina Faso.title: Kangaba: Six dead in the landslide...
Burkina Faso.summary: Kangaba: Six dead in the landslide of a mining well in Nouga Six people died last Friday in the landslide of a mining well, transformed into a gallery, in the rural commune of Nouga, precisely on a very isolated gold mining site in the village of Dioulafoundou. According to our information, the people who died are all nationals of Burkina Faso Immediately informed, the Prefect of Circle, accompanied by the officials of the Police, the National Gendarmerie, the National Guard, the Civil Protection Rescue Center, the sanitation and water and forest services, went to the scene.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: Islamist Armed Group Targets Civilians
Burkina Faso.summary: - An Al-Qaeda-linked armed group killed at least 27 civilians in two attacks in Burkina Faso’s northern Yatenga province in September 2026. - The group’s relentless, unlawful attacks put civilians across Burkina Faso at grave risk. The laws of war prohibit attacking civilians, and those who order, commit, or assist serious violations of the laws of war with criminal intent may be prosecuted for war crimes.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: Two fiancés die in Tenkodogo after an altercation involving a firearm
Burkina Faso.summary: A trader and a non-commissioned officer of the defense and security forces, presented as fiancés, died at the Tenkodogo Regional Hospital Center (CHR) after an altercation that occurred on the night of November 1 to 2, 2026 in Sector 6, according to testimonies collected by the Burkina Faso Information Agency (AIB) . The two victims, identified as Jeanne Yoda and Adama Tiendrébéogo, allegedly had an argument near a pharmacy, not far from the hospital.

Niger.title: Niger signs cooperation deal with military leader in eastern Libya
Niger.summary: Niger signed a memorandum of understanding with eastern Libya’s military commander Khalifa Haftar on Sunday to strengthen their bilateral relations. The agreement to expand cooperation in “various fields” was approved by Nigerien Prime Minister Ali Mahaman Lamine Zeine. He visited Benghazi together with several political and military officials.

Niger.title: An example of cooperation :
Niger.summary: This is an example of South-South cooperation that must do its bit on the African continent. Algeria has decided to provide military support to its neighbour, Niger, with which it had, until recently, tense relations. If relations between the two had been somewhat blurred, pragmatism eventually took over, giving way to a return to a warming of cooperation between the two countries .
